description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class for integration tests related to persistence of 'thing search' functionalities in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes setup and teardown methods for MongoDB resources and Akka actor systems, as well as utility methods for counting and retrieving test data.

classes.name: AbstractThingSearchPersistenceITBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for integration tests of the 'thing search' persistence layer in the Eclipse Ditto project, managing setup and teardown of resources, and providing utility methods for testing.

methods.name: startMongoResource
methods.description: Initializes the MongoDB resource for testing, including creating the query builder factory.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Sets up the actor system, persistence instances, and collection before each test run.

methods.name: provideReadPersistence
methods.description: Creates and initializes the MongoDB-based persistence instance used for reading.

methods.name: provideWritePersistence
methods.description: Creates the stream used for writing/updating during tests.

methods.name: provideClientWrapper
methods.description: Creates and configures the MongoDB client wrapper with connection parameters.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Cleans up resources after each test, including dropping collections and shutting down actor systems.

methods.name: dropCollections
methods.description: Drops specified MongoDB collections with backoff retries.

methods.name: dropCollectionWithBackoff
methods.description: Attempts to drop a MongoDB collection with retries and backoff in case of failure.

methods.name: stopMongoResource
methods.description: Stops the MongoDB resource after all tests are complete.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts the number of documents matching a query, optionally filtered by known subjects.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all ThingId results matching a query, optionally filtered by known subjects.

methods.name: runBlockingWithReturn
methods.description: Runs an Akka stream source and blocks until a single result is obtained.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns the MongoDB client used in tests.

methods.name: getMaterializer
methods.description: Provides the Akka Materializer for streaming operations.

methods.name: waitFor
methods.description: Collects all elements from a source stream into a list, blocking until complete.
